protocol_standardization.note: The full source was truncated, so no grep of the whole codebase was possible.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the Entity Extraction Agent interprets the question, the Metadata Retrieval Agent grounds it in the schema, the Query Logic Agent builds a high- level plan

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Short-term memory captures the state of the ongoing interaction, including the current user question and intermediate outputs from agents.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Long-term memory stores past user questions, generated queries at each step, execution results, employed functions, and user feedback.
long_term_memory.note: Described in the paper only; not seen in the shown code.

state_persistence.note: No run-loop persistence surface was visible in the shown code.

self_verification.evidence_quote: hands the rows back to an LLM-assisted evaluator to confirm whether the returned sample correctly answers the user's question
self_verification.note: The Review Agent performs a sandboxed dry run with LIMIT 10, then an LLM judge assesses the result.

rollback.evidence_quote: a built-in security mechanism blocks any query that attempts to add new rows (INSERT), modify existing data (UPDATE)
rollback.note: Read-only design, so there is nothing to revert. Coded none on the basis of the paper only.

termination_condition.note: The pipeline ends after the review stage; the loop code was truncated.

timeouts.note: Timeout on the Nominatim geocoding call; SQL execution timeouts were not visible.
